title: Give Thanks
subtitle: A Prayer for the Table
tagline: One prayer for the meal, and one question to ask before the plates are passed.
headline: A Prayer for the Table
seo_title: A Thanksgiving Prayer for the Table
seo_description: A short Thanksgiving prayer for men to pray over the meal with family and friends, and one question to ask around the table before the plates are passed.
og_image_alt: A Prayer for the Table: One prayer for the meal, and one question to ask before the plates are passed. TheWrkShop.

scriptures.text: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.

blocks.text: Just a prayer you can pray over the table, and one question to ask before the plates are passed.
Father, thank You for this food, this table, and the people around it.

items: Thank You for the ones who came before us,
and the faith they passed down.
Thank You for what You carried us through this year,
and for what You’re still carrying us through.
Make us grateful for what we have,
generous with what we’ve been given,
and mindful of anyone without a seat at a table today.

blocks.text: Remind us that every good gift comes from You.
“What’s one thing God did for you this year?”
Go first. Your family will follow your lead.
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good; his love endures forever.
Happy Thanksgiving from all of us at TheWrkShop.
